law_name: Federal Law No. 152-FZ on Personal Data
enforcement_authority: Federal Service for Supervision of Communications, Information Technology and Mass Media (Roskomnadzor)
penalties_range: Up to RUB 15M per leak (>100k subjects or special categories); repeat leaks: 1-3% of revenue, min RUB 20M, max RUB 500M
deceased_data: Protected: if the deceased gave no consent while alive, heirs give written consent to processing (art. 9; no time limit stated)
research_exemption: Processing without consent for statistical or other research purposes (not marketing, art. 15) if data are mandatorily depersonalised (art. 6(1)(9))
genetic_data: No specific rule: genetic data not among special categories (art. 10: race, nationality, politics, religion, health, intimate life); biometric rules art. 11 (unconfirmed)
notes: Law 420-FZ (in force 2025-05-30) sharply raised leak fines, turnover-based for repeat leaks
